subject: English Home Language

show.line: Numbers are written too! Start at the top. One is a line down. Let's write our numerals.

rounds.prompt: Draw two with your finger. Go round at the top, then along the bottom.
Draw three with your finger. Make one bump, then another bump.
Which numeral is written the right way round?
Draw six with your finger. Curl down, then round into a ball at the bottom.
Draw zero with your finger. Start at the top and go all the way round.
Which numeral is written the right way round?
rounds.praise: Across the top, then slide down!

rounds.prompt: Draw nine with your finger. A ball at the top, then a line down.

hints: Start at the top. Numbers sit on the line.
Say the number as you draw it.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write a six.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The ball is at the top. That is a nine.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Six has its ball at the bottom!

parent_line: Can write the numerals 0 to 9 the right way round.
